'''Matt Miller''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[March 2001 Parker tournament]] on 17 March 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS Abyssin Swarm]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS (patrol craft / palace raiders)]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2019">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-04-parker-co-3-17-01-downward-spirald2019/ parker-co-3-17-01-downward-spiral], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 4 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-04-parker-co-3-17-01-downward-spirald2019/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
